properties.entry: SELECT d.imeiNumber AS id, d.imeiNumber AS uniqueId FROM Device d INNER JOIN Account a ON a.accountID = d.accountID LEFT JOIN User u ON u.accountID = d.accountID AND u.userID = :user WHERE d.accountID = :account AND d.deviceID = :device AND d.imeiNumber REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' AND (u.password = :password OR ((:user = '' OR :user = 'admin') AND a.password = :password)) LIMIT 1;
